title: Behavior Random Fly
description: Allows a mob to randomly fly around.

priority.description: As priority approaches 0, the priority is increased. The higher the priority, the sooner this behavior will be executed as a goal.

can_land_on_trees.description: Whether the entity may land on top of trees when choosing a destination.

xz_dist.description: Maximum horizontal distance in blocks of the destination.

y_dist.description: Maximum vertical distance in blocks of the destination.
